script: The sunlight on your face right now left the Sun about 8 minutes ago. But the energy carrying it spent thousands of years working its way out from the core. The Sun is so big that more than a million Earths could fit inside it. Its core burns at around 15 million degrees Celsius. Every second, it turns about 4 million tons of matter into pure energy.
